name: Alexander-Dual Linear-Quotients Criterion
statement: For an isometrically embedded finite binary family $X\subseteq Q_E$, let $J_X=(m_x:x\in X)$ with $m_x=\prod_{e\in E}v_{e,1-x_e}$. Then $X$ is dismantlable ample exactly when the equigenerated squarefree ideal $J_X$ has a linear-quotient order.
hypotheses: The displayed cube embedding is isometric; constant coordinates may be removed without changing the criterion.
